sequence.detail: Ricky Saints attacked during the tag match, causing a disqualification
Penta emerged and requested a six-man tag team match
Penta, Trick Williams and Rey Fenix defeated Sami Zayn, Johnny Gargano and Ricky Saints

storylines.consequence: Trick Williams gains momentum ahead of his Undisputed WWE Title match against Sami Zayn

storylines.development: Aldis announced Rhodes versus Orton at Crown Jewel; Rhodes requested a Last Man Standing Match
storylines.consequence: Crown Jewel match set with Last Man Standing stipulation

storylines.development: The two traded insults during a sit-down interview
storylines.consequence: Their Brooklyn showdown was promoted for two weeks later

storylines.development: After Chelsea Green retained, Judgment Day attacked; Tiffany Stratton made the save and nearly cashed in Money in the Bank
storylines.consequence: Women's title and Money in the Bank tensions escalated
